请管理员在服务器设置中配置 LLM 地址和模型。: Ask an administrator to configure the LLM URL and model in Server settings.

请填写 LLM 地址和模型: Enter the LLM URL and model.

请管理员配置 LLM 地址和模型: Ask an administrator to configure the LLM URL and model.

当时未记录详细原因，无法确定具体故障。: No detailed reason was recorded at the time. The exact cause is unknown.
